mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, John Ehlers' canonical 125-period Decycler Oscillator crossing zero on completed four-hour BTC auctions identifies a near-zero-lag reversal in the isolated trend component; follow the new oscillator sign for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long on a strict nonpositive-to-positive Decycler Oscillator crossing; short on a strict nonnegative-to-negative crossing
mechanism.why_distinct: The Decycler Oscillator recursively subtracts a two-pole high-pass component from close, then high-pass filters that decycled trend at half the original period and normalizes by current close. It is not a moving-average crossover, return sum, range oscillator, regression, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the published near-zero-lag trend reversal must coincide with completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse cascaded recursive high-pass trend-component sign reversals are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.decycler: Close minus the recursively filtered 125-period high-frequency component
features.decycler_oscillator: second published two-pole high-pass recursion over Decycle using 0.5*HPPeriod, normalized as 100*K*DecycleOsc/Close
features.event: strict finite normalized oscillator zero crossing from the immediately prior finite oscillator
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.recursive_reset: all recursive filter state resets after any invalid completed four-hour bar and requires three consecutive valid inputs before output

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Ehlers Decycler Oscillator(125,1) zero crossing under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no period, recursion, initialization, threshold, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: John F. Ehlers, Decyclers, TASC September 2015
external_basis.fixed_definition: HPPeriod=125 and K=1; published alpha and two-pole high-pass recursions; Decycle=Close-HP; second high-pass uses half-period; oscillator=100*K*DecycleOsc/Close; zero line
external_basis.selection_use: published default parameters, formula, normalization, and zero line only; no incidence or outcomes
